patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Cognism and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Cognism only if your buying job matches “Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong ” rather than Salesloft's shape. Choose Salesloft only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, seque” rather than Cognism's shape. Workflow advantage: Cognism leans data-enrichment, contact-management; Salesloft leans sales-engagement, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Cognism is Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment — quote-led Sale; Salesloft is Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, sequencing, coaching; talk-to-sales pricing..
- Workflow coverage skew: Cognism-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management vs Salesloft-leaning sales-engagement, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Cognism — Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Salesloft — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Cognism: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Sales Prospecting Standard/Pro list prices are not published on /pricing; Salesloft: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — talk-to-sales only.

Poor-fit cases: Cognism is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach · Salesloft is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Cognism if you actually need Salesloft's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM s)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
